research_metadata.coverage_notes: Manang is one of the most remote and least populated districts in Nepal, situated in the Gandaki Province. Extensive search across Tribhuvan University constituent/affiliated campus lists, UGC Nepal reports, Ministry of Education records, and CTEVT portals revealed that there are currently no fully-fledged higher education institutions (colleges offering Bachelor's, Master's, or higher degree programs) physically operating within Manang district. Educational facilities in Manang are primarily limited to school-level education up to Grade 10 or Higher Secondary (+2 levels under NEB), but these do not constitute standalone higher education degree-granting colleges as defined by the criteria.

research_gaps: No higher education institutions (universities, constituent campuses, or affiliated colleges) exist within Manang district boundaries. Students pursuing higher education typically move to Gandaki Province's capital Pokhara or to Kathmandu.
